requires: exact target or verified novel identity

operation_requirements.add: verified novel identity and complete geometry
operation_requirements.marking_change: defined marking value and independently verified property evidence; no replacement geometry
operation_requirements.delete: fully observed causal support for absence on the same target; no replacement geometry

write_policy.shared_boundary_aliases: physical identity may be known; synchronized edits of all references remain unverified

confirmation_contract.model_detection: Computed local geometric decision; independent of map-write eligibility.
confirmation_contract.reference_confirmation: Delivered M8 labels and current states, read only after prediction freeze.
confirmation_contract.execution: Known reference changes replay into an isolated map copy; model geometry is not promoted to a full-map patch.

method.policy_selection: Semantic target and change operation; geometric quality defaults fixed before evaluation
method.scope: Frozen perception inputs; structure/state routing, not a duration classifier

policy.score_definition: Occupancy: supplied-row source/target/overlap checks. Markings: observed geometry quality with computed exact-window local reference and fixed-anchor residual; neither score is a probability.

state_event_layer.geometry_semantics: Source city-coordinate geometry; not asserted WGS84 longitude/latitude.

updated_map.coordinates: City XY; no heights in ArgoTweak input

rollback_map.coordinates: City XY; no heights in ArgoTweak input

prior_metadata.coordinates: City XY; no heights in ArgoTweak input

version.hash_format: canonical JSON sorted keys; compact separators

nuscenes.label_source: Source candidate types and annotation-backed occupancy; no independent structure-versus-state labels
limitations: Source occupancy uses annotation-backed footprints, not rerun camera detection.
Semantic routing is not proof that the candidate change is real.
Old temporary/permanent labels are not structure/state ground truth.
No scene identity or event lifetime is used to choose a map layer.

argoverse.prediction_unit: one exact physical boundary; aliases never expand into multiple true positives
argoverse.exact_object_scope_note: Coarse any-change object diagnostic on single-reference predictions only, not boundary/type accuracy. Multi-alias output is excluded; main geometry metrics above check the actual claimed boundary.

task_support_breakdown.note: Reference records can share physical geometry. NONE is unpainted or logical lane geometry, not a missing painted-line measurement; additions and semantic/topology changes require different observations.

layer_on_true_geometry_hits.label_source: Supplied prior/current lane geometry; no lifetime assumption.

limitations: Constructed-train development scene; parameters not fitted to these labels.
Whole supplied geometry scope includes unobserved areas; not visibility-conditioned accuracy.
Geometry-only scope excludes additions, topology, lane-use, color and unknown paint references.
Correct layer identity does not cancel a wrong boundary, side, geometry or operation.

full_boundary_geometry.baseline_description: Same frozen observations and numeric policy with the former NONE/UNKNOWN veto; evaluated on the same full scope.
full_boundary_geometry.metric_interpretation: Changed-boundary identity retrieval only; a true hit may still predict incorrect local geometry.

local_geometry_summary.scope: All aliases must have a same-anchor truth offset and absolute median-offset error within tolerance; not full-patch correctness.

full_boundary_geometry.local_geometry_check_scope: Same-anchor and representative-curve agreement, evaluated after prediction freeze; not whole-feature replacement accuracy.
limitations: Boundary retrieval is not the 98-object all-change task.
New objects, crossing changes, marking attributes, lane use and connectivity need additional observation branches.
Unobserved boundaries remain in the fixed recall denominator.
Constructed-train development scene; not independent test accuracy.
A changed boundary identity alone does not establish that the predicted geometry or edit is correct.

comparison.unit: old M3 candidate groups versus new physical-boundary windows; use fixed-scope metrics for accuracy comparison

limitations: Map layer is classified by target semantics, not observed lifetime.
Routing is an explicit semantic classifier, not a trained or calibrated ML model.
Reliability describes observed-segment conflict, not correctness of the full map.
A structural candidate needs a verified full edit before base-map mutation.
Missing observations and TTL expiry are not observed recovery.
